exposure: Induced nulliparas with a term singleton cephalic pregnancy
Preterm twin gestation with the first twin in non-cephalic presentation
preterm twin gestation with the first twin in non-cephalic presentation
cohort: 228,562 pregnant women in 19 US hospitals between 2002-2008
finding: The study found that while caesarean delivery rates could potentially be safely reduced in several obstetrical subgroups, it was associated with improved maternal and perinatal outcomes in singleton preterm breech presentation and preterm twins with the first twin in non-cephalic presentation.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was not significantly associated with perinatal outcomes in most subgroups, but improved outcomes in singleton preterm breech and preterm twins with non-cephalic presentation.
